name: Контратака (1)
description:
The counterattack is an advanced tactic. When the opponent attacks something, you have a tendency to respond to the attack. However, this is not mandatory. There are situations in which it is smarter to organize a counterattack.

The difficulty of the counterattack is that you keep all options open by considering many different moves. For a counterattack to be effective, it is important that the counterattack is more threatening than the opponent's attack.

What do you have to do?

Confuse the opponent with a counterattack.

examples.text: тура на b8 атакується? Це не проблема, оскільки чорні можуть контратакувати за допомогою 1...Bf5! Оскільки тури тепер з’єднані, кінь на a6 також раптово висить.
